description: Mandatory 1C first-use profile (brief b76e6b1b section 7 as corrected by f17b49a6 section 3). {MAX} is the root's max_content_len_bytes; {ACTION} is the L3 block action.
policy_template:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        matches: "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$"
        max_length: 128
      content:
        type: string
        max_length: {MAX}
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: block, block_action: {ACTION} }
relaxed_template:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        max_length: 128
      content:
        type: string
        max_length: {MAX}
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: block, block_action: {ACTION} }
not_enforced_template:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        matches: "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$"
        max_length: 128
      content:
        type: string
        max_length: {MAX}
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: shadow }
